name: lab_help
out: {"result":"spawn <count> <image> [--mem MiB] [--cpus CPUs] [--disk 4 | 8 | 16 | 32 | 64] [--extra-disk GiB,...] [--name name] [--nics NICs] [--net network,... | --no-net] [--addr address,...] [--no-gateway]","data":{"verb":"spawn","about":"boot machines","tool":"machines_spawn","usage":"spawn <count> <image> [--mem MiB] [--cpus CPUs] [--disk 4 | 8 | 16 | 32 | 64] [--extra-disk GiB,...] [--name name] [--nics NICs] [--net network,... | --no-net] [--addr address,...] [--no-gateway]","description":"Boot new Linux machines and return their names. Each boots on its own: ls (machines_list) says when it is ready, or failed and why. A NIC that is plugged in takes one of switch0's 8 ports. The package gateway gives eth0 10.0.2.15 and a default route, for package installs only. gateway off leaves it out, so DHCP on eth0 goes to the other machines. Chosen addresses are set again at every boot, and each machine's /etc/hosts names the others.","arguments":[{"field":"count","written":"<count>","about":"How many machines. The lab holds 8.","required":true,"default":null},{"field":"image","written":"<image>","about":"alpine, debian or lab: Alpine with iproute2, tcpdump, curl, dig, ssh, nginx, strace, sfdisk and mkfs installed, for use offline.","required":true,"default":null},{"field":"mem","written":"[--mem MiB]","about":"The memory of each machine, in MiB, up to 4096.","required":false,"default":"256"},{"field":"cpus","written":"[--cpus CPUs]","about":"The CPUs of each machine, 1 to 16.","required":false,"default":"2"},{"field":"disk","written":"[--disk 4 | 8 | 16 | 32 | 64]","about":"The size in GiB of /dev/wdb, the disk with the machine's own files.","required":false,"default":"4"},{"field":"extraDisk","written":"[--extra-disk GiB,...]","about":"Blank disks to add, as whole GiB each, such as 1,4: up to 4, of 1 to 64. They are /dev/wdc and on, with no file system.","required":false,"default":null},{"field":"name","written":"[--name name]","about":"The machine's name and hostname: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, such as web-1. Left out, node and a number. Needs count 1.","required":false,"default":null},{"field":"nics","written":"[--nics NICs]","about":"The NICs of each machine, 1 to 4: eth0 and on. One that is plugged in takes a port.","required":false,"default":"1"},{"field":"net","written":"[--net network,... | --no-net]","about":"switch0 or none for every NIC, or a comma list with one for each, eth0 first, such as switch0,none. A NIC with none boots unplugged.","required":false,"default":"switch0"},{"field":"addr","written":"[--addr address,...]","about":"Each NIC's address, eth0 first, such as 10.1.0.1/24,none. none leaves it up without one. Left out, eth0 has one in 10.88.0.0/24. Needs count 1.","required":false,"default":null},{"field":"gateway","written":"[--no-gateway]","about":"off (--no-gateway) leaves out the package gateway: its address and default route on eth0, its DHCP there, and package installs.","required":false,"default":null}],"examp
